# Command-line reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from the argparse parser in
     backend/cli.py. Do not edit by hand: change the parser's help text and rerun
     the script. CI fails when this page is out of date. -->

Every command is run as `python -m backend.cli [options] <command> ...` from the
repository root. Options that apply to every command go **before** the command name.

## Global options

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--store` `STORE` | evidence store directory (default: evidence_store) |
| `--offline` | never contact the TSA; timestamps and anchors stay PENDING |

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`seal`](#seal) | seal a pcap and store it as a new case |
| [`analyze`](#analyze) | seal, store and analyse a pcap; print its findings |
| [`tamper-demo`](#tamper-demo) | in a throwaway store: seal a copy, verify, flip one stored byte, verify again |
| [`retry-timestamps`](#retry-timestamps) | retry every PENDING seal |
| [`verify`](#verify) | re-check a stored case: INTACT, ALTERED or INCOMPLETE |

## seal {#seal}

Seal a pcap and store it as a new case.

```text
usage: python -m backend.cli seal [-h] pcap
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `pcap` | path to a classic .pcap capture (not pcapng) |

## analyze {#analyze}

Seal, store and analyse a pcap; print its findings.

```text
usage: python -m backend.cli analyze [-h] pcap
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `pcap` | path to a classic .pcap capture (not pcapng) |

## tamper-demo {#tamper-demo}

In a throwaway store: seal a copy, verify, flip one stored byte, verify again.

```text
usage: python -m backend.cli tamper-demo [-h] pcap
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `pcap` | path to a classic .pcap capture (not pcapng) |

## retry-timestamps {#retry-timestamps}

Retry every PENDING seal.

```text
usage: python -m backend.cli retry-timestamps [-h]
```

This command takes no arguments of its own.

## verify {#verify}

Re-check a stored case: INTACT, ALTERED or INCOMPLETE.

```text
usage: python -m backend.cli verify [-h] case_id
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `case_id` | case id printed by seal or analyze |

## Exit codes

```text
exit codes:
  0  success; verify: INTACT; tamper-demo: the altered copy was caught
  1  error: missing file, not a pcap, too large, unknown case, stored copy
     altered (one "error:" line on stderr); verify: ALTERED
  2  retry-timestamps left at least one seal PENDING; verify: INCOMPLETE
     (nothing failed, a timestamp is still PENDING); also a usage error
```

Errors print one `error: ...` line on standard error.
